answer: What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the quartz until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the meadow of the next round.
